lab.about:
The MAIA (Medical Artificial Intelligence-based Applications) lab at HIT – Holon Institute of Technology was established in 2020. We build accessible, easy-to-use mobile and tablet applications for patients and clinical teams.

Our apps track patient progress, make communication between patients and therapists easier, and replace outdated pen-and-paper methods with digital tools. Modernizing these processes improves patient care and produces rich data, which we use to build AI-driven decision-support tools for medical staff.
lab.mission:
- **Connect patients and therapists** remotely, wherever treatment continues.
- **Give therapists detailed patient data** and let patients see their own progress.
- **Digitize pen-and-paper cognitive tests** to improve accuracy, consistency and data collection.
- **Turn collected data into AI decision support** for clinical teams.
- **Integrate sensors** — built-in device sensors and medical equipment — into everyday care.
- **Engage students**: projects start with Computer Science and Medical Technologies students working with a lab supervisor, then move to the lab for further development.
